title: 발음이 달라
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a syncopated four-bar loop with prominent fret noise. A warm electric bass enters on the first beat of the verse, following the root notes of the guitar progression. The male tenor vocals are dry and intimate with light compression and subtle plate reverb. The tempo is 82 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal delivery alternates between a conversational chest voice and a light, airy falsetto during melodic leaps. A subtle shaker provides a steady sixteenth-note pulse starting in the second half of the verse.
